categories.main_business_segments: Samhwa Crown & Closure Co., Ltd operates primarily in two business segments: the CAP division, specializing in manufacturing and selling various bottle caps including plastic and metal caps, and the Plastic Container division, focusing on manufacturing cosmetic containers. The CAP division accounts for approximately 83.44% of sales, while the Plastic Container division contributes about 16.56%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies for producing plastic caps (lightweight, strong, and color-customizable) and metal caps (Crown, Ropp, White caps) with features like superior sealing and anti-counterfeiting. The Plastic Container division employs integrated production systems including injection molding, UV coating, and assembly to deliver customized cosmetic containers. Continuous R&D and technology partnerships underpin product innovation and quality improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic beverage companies, alcoholic beverage producers, and cosmetic product manufacturers. The CAP division serves the beverage, liquor, pharmaceutical, and food packaging markets domestically and exports to over 10 countries. The Plastic Container division primarily serves cosmetic brands requiring customized packaging solutions, with major clients like LG Household & Health Care.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Ansan and Uiwang. It exports products to approximately 10 countries worldwide and has established a subsidiary in the USA (SAMHWA CROWN USA, INC.) to enhance local market presence. The company also maintains sales offices in Seoul.
categories.supply_chain_position: Samhwa Crown & Closure operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of intermediate packaging products (bottle caps and cosmetic containers) supplied directly to beverage and cosmetic manufacturers. It does not engage in downstream retail or upstream raw material extraction but procures raw materials like aluminum, plastic resins, and inks for production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation and R&D to improve product quality and develop new cap designs such as hinge caps, flow control caps, and lightweight caps. It maintains technology licensing agreements with global partners and invests in production capacity expansion and quality enhancement. The Plastic Container division focuses on mold design, container aesthetics, and rapid response to customer demands in the fast-changing cosmetics market.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of manufactured products to beverage and cosmetic companies, both domestically and internationally. The company operates on a made-to-order basis, especially for cosmetic containers, and receives technology licensing fees under agreements with foreign partners. There is no indication of subscription or advertising revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Samhwa Crown & Closure is positioned as the leading comprehensive bottle cap manufacturer in South Korea, uniquely supplying both plastic and metal caps. It holds a competitive edge through technological capabilities, quality certifications, and exclusive designation as a tax seal cap manufacturer by the National Tax Service. The Plastic Container division competes in a growing cosmetics packaging market with a focus on quality and design innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 157.9 billion KRW with a slight growth compared to the previous year. Total assets stand at about 201 billion KRW, with a debt-to-equity ratio of 90%. The company experienced a net loss in 2023 but improved from prior years, and it continues to invest in productivity and quality enhancements to expand market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality, technologically advanced bottle caps and cosmetic containers tailored to customer specifications, emphasizing superior sealing, anti-counterfeiting features, and design flexibility. Its unique position as the only domestic supplier of both plastic and metal caps, combined with strong R&D capabilities and exclusive tax seal manufacturing rights, differentiates it in the market. The Plastic Container division's integrated production system ensures rapid, customized responses to evolving cosmetic industry trends.
